partnership_announcements.description: Zenity and Amazon Web Services formed a new integration partnership linking Zenity’s AI agent security platform with the AWS Security Hub Extended plan, enabling AI agent security findings to flow into AWS Security Hub and be correlated with broader enterprise threats.

press_references.value: Zenity Expands Integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio to Secure AI Agents at Scale

partnership_announcements.description: Zenity announced an expanded integration with Microsoft Copilot Studio to provide native, inline attack prevention and policy enforcement for AI agents, available in public preview via Azure Marketplace.

press_references.value: Zenity Selected for the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program to Secure AI Agents Everywhere

partnership_announcements.description: Zenity has been selected for the Microsoft for Startups Pegasus Program, an invite-only initiative to help B2B startups with opportunity generation and acceleration. This partnership will allow Zenity to work closely with Microsoft to scale adoption and security for business productivity tools like Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Studio, and Power Platform.

research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Zenity is researching data flow analysis for computing systems deploying multiple software applications. The work titled data flow analysis for computing systems deploying multiple software focuses on constructing data flow graphs with vertices for data locations and edges for data movements across applications. This supports understanding and controlling how information traverses SaaS, cloud, and endpoint environments, highlighting research in multi application data flow modeling and cross system data movement analysis.

overview_description.description: Zenity provides an AI security and governance platform designed to help organizations discover, monitor, and secure AI agents, low-code applications, and automations. The platform provides visibility into AI agent activity, risk assessment, policy enforcement, and threat protection across enterprise environments. It supports governance of AI systems by managing agent configurations, permissions, behaviors, and runtime activities.
